preparation: Same physical axial plane on verified identical grids; no fitted transform applied.
limitation: No independently validated CT-MR alignment, landmarks, patient identifiers or original acquisition provenance supplied. Shared geometry does not establish anatomical correspondence.
registration_intensities: Source units with Gaussian sigma 0.65 pixels; no clipping, range rescaling or histogram matching. Display windows are separate.
metric_domain: Full valid image overlap, including real background; no circular/anatomical ROI. Exclude only out-of-image samples and generated padding.
